scripts.preinstall: npx only-allow pnpm && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const nvmrc = fs.readFileSync('.nvmrc', 'utf8').trim(); const current = process.version.slice(1); if (current !== nvmrc) { console.error('❌ Node版本错误: 需要 ' + nvmrc + ', 当前是 ' + current); console.error('💡 请运行: nvm use '+ nvmrc); process.exit(1); }"
